VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the bug and that all 52 tests pass locally, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 52 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Without CI logs or test output, there is no way to confirm the fix actually works or that no regressions were introduced.
